import json
from pathlib import Path
cur_p = sorted(Path("outgoing").glob("ethan_bigdata_jobs_*.json"))[-1]
prev_p = Path("outgoing/ethan_bigdata_jobs_20260909_1126.json")
cur = json.loads(cur_p.read_text())
prev = json.loads(prev_p.read_text()) if prev_p.exists() else {"jobs": [], "hit_count": 0}
prev_links = {j["link"] for j in prev["jobs"]}
prev_texts = {j["text"][:120] for j in prev["jobs"]}
strong_kw = ("大数据开发","数仓","数据开发","数据平台","大数据架构","大数据工程","数据仓库","数据工程","湖仓","资深大数据","数据负责人","高级数仓","大数据工程师","大数据DBA")
print(f"\n本次: {cur['hit_count']} · 近{cur['days']}天 · 仅远程  (文件 {cur_p.name})")
print(f"上次(今早): {prev['hit_count']}")
new = [j for j in cur["jobs"] if j["link"] not in prev_links and j["text"][:120] not in prev_texts]
print(f"\n=== 相对今早新增 ({len(new)}) ===")
seen = set()
for j in new:
    key = j["text"][:80]
    roles = "、".join(j["role_hits"][:6])
    rem = "、".join(j.get("remote_hits") or [])
    dup = " (同文复发)" if key in seen else ""
    seen.add(key)
    print(f"{j['date']} | {roles} | {rem}{dup}")
    print(f"  {j['link']}")
print("\n=== 强岗摘要 ===")
for j in cur["jobs"]:
    roles = "、".join(j["role_hits"][:5])
    is_strong = any(s in roles for s in strong_kw) or any(s in j["text"][:250] for s in strong_kw)
    if not is_strong:
        continue
    # only show last 3 days + classic strong
    if j["date"] >= "2026-09-07" or any(s in roles for s in ("资深大数据","数据负责人","数仓架构","大数据架构")):
        rem = "、".join(j.get("remote_hits") or [])
        print(f"★ {j['date']} | {roles} | {rem}")
        print(f"  {j['link']}")
